rules.name: Internal SSH Authentication Failure Burst
rules.description: Detects five failed SSH login attempts from the same source to the same host and username within ten minutes. This may indicate password guessing, but it does not prove that a login succeeded.
rules.note:
## Investigation

Review the source system, target host, username, authentication method, and exact time of the failures. Check whether the source is an approved administrator workstation, jump host, scanner, or penetration-test system. Look for successful logins immediately before and after the failures, and confirm the activity with the system owner.

## Response

If the activity is unexplained or unauthorised, preserve the relevant logs and escalate to the SOC and system owner for credential and host review. Do not automatically block, isolate, reset passwords, or disable accounts based on this alert alone.
author: SOC Analyst
false_positives: Authorized vulnerability scanners, penetration tests, administrators testing credentials, and misconfigured automation may generate repeated failures.
rules.query: event.dataset:"system.auth" and event.action:"ssh_login" and event.outcome:"failure" and source.ip:* and user.name:*

rules.name: PAN-OS Internal ICMP Host Discovery
rules.description: Detects one private source contacting at least 100 private destinations with ICMP within five minutes. This can indicate host discovery, but it is not proof of an attack.
rules.note:
## Investigation

Review the source system, number and range of destinations, time window, and whether the activity came from an approved monitoring system, vulnerability scanner, or network-management tool. Check for later port scans or service connections from the same source.

## Response

Confirm the source owner and whether the activity was scheduled or authorised. If it is unexplained, preserve the relevant logs and escalate to the SOC and system owner. Do not automatically block, isolate, reset passwords, or disable accounts based on this alert alone.
author: SOC Analyst
false_positives: Approved vulnerability scanners, monitoring systems, and network-management tools performing ICMP discovery.
rules.query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"TRAFFIC" and event.action:"flow_started" and network.transport:"icmp" and source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16) and destination.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16)
